checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so it is on the same page as the prices.
The includesText lists arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits and authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or third parties.
The list shows only Basic Services of Funeral Director and Staff and Overhead as the services overhead fee, with no second mandatory fee.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the Embalming $795 price is on page 1, so they are on the same page.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket service; the disclosure says embalming is not required except in certain special cases.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation range $1,595 to $1,945 is on page 2, so they are on the same page.
Direct cremation is offered with options including container provided by purchaser, and no text says a casket is required.
The direct cremation includesText lists removal, transportation and cremation, and no separate cash advance list is shown to create ambiguity.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial all have their own priced lines, and no package or policy mentions an unpriced item.
The list offers only required single-price items and itemized goods and services; no optional combination package is shown.
No text asserts a purchase is required by law, cemetery or crematory beyond the prescribed disclosure language.
No text claims delay of decomposition or protection from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts the required disclosures, and the disclosures are printed in full.
